item.title: 18 mil reproducciones · 587 reacciones | Nesta segunda-feira (05), durante uma reunião com aliados para decidir a estratégia de campanha para o segundo turno, o presidente Lula (PT) falou sobre o que pretende fazer nos próximos vinte dias para angariar mais eleitores. "Vinte dias em que a gente vai ter que colocar pra fora aquilo que a gente deveria estar colocando o ano inteiro, tentando desnudar, desnudar o que está por detrás da eleição de um possível herdeiro do fascismo nesse país", disse. "É sair para trabalhar. Eu estou convencido, veja, vocês pensam que eu não fiquei decepcionado? Toda eleição eu fico decepcionado, porque toda eu quero ganhar no primeiro turno. Eu acho que eu tenho que fazer mais rádio". No último domingo (04), Lula teve 45% dos votos, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) teve 47%. Os dois se enfrentam em um segundo turno, que acontece no próximo dia 25 de outubro. ➡️ #EmPauta - de segunda a sexta, às 20h, na #GloboNews. Assista na TV e no @globoplay #eleições2026 #lula #política | GloboNews

item.title: No es solo la Presidencia: la derecha se consolida en el Congreso de Brasil y potencia a Bolsonaro
item.description: El Partido Liberal, plataforma de la candidatura presidencial de Flávio Bolsonaro, consiguió 121 escaños en la Cámara de Diputados y pasó de 15 a 28 asientos en el Senado, lo que se traduce en la mayor representación de un solo partido en ambas cámaras en casi 40 años. Con el apoyo de otras fuerzas de tendencia conservadora, Bolsonaro garantizaría así una cómoda gobernabilidad, en caso de ser electo presidente, y podría perseguir, incluso, la prometida amnistía a su padre. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Los supervivientes de Nova vuelven a bailar tres años después del 7 de octubre: «No vamos a parar»
item.description: Israel afronta el tercer aniversario del 7 de octubre en plena carrera electoral y el ataque sorpresa de Hamás está en el centro del debate político. Medios como 'Haaretz' desvelaron que Benjamín Netanyahu recibió un aviso previo sobre los planes de los islamistas, pero no hizo caso . El primer ministro, que bloquea la puesta en marcha de una comisión de investigación sobre lo sucedido, lo niega. En medio del pulso político, miles de supervivientes rehacen sus vidas tras haber superado aquel «sábado negro» que dejó alrededor de 1.200 muertos y 251 secuestrados , según datos oficiales… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Quebec votes as separatist surge poses test for Canada PM
item.description: Quebec separatists eyed a return to power in Canada's majority French-speaking province Monday in an election that could test Prime Minister Mark Carney's message of national unity to confront the United States. Carney is popular in Quebec, and the possible success of the separatist Parti Quebecois (PQ) is not seen as a repudiation of his stance toward President Donald Trump, whose trade war and annexation threats have infuriated Canadians. FRANCE 24's Christopher Guly reports from Ottawa. Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Sanchez chose 'best moment in a sea of troubles' to call for snap election, analyst says
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Monday called an early election for November 29, aiming to increase his parliamentary support after lawmakers last week rejected proposals to address a housing crisis that has drawn nationwide protests. Speaking with FRANCE 24's Mark Owen, Javier Carbonell, Policy Analyst at the European Policy Centre, explains that Sanchez has chosen "the best moment in a sea of troubles" to call snap elections as he is likely to capitalise on the mobilisation of left-wing voters during the housing protests. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: La derecha celebra, la izquierda se organiza: así reacciona la política en España al adelanto electoral
item.description: El líder opositor Alberto Núñez Feijóo, que llevaba meses reclamando comicios anticipados, destacó que "por fin votaremos y España podrá elegir el país que quiere ser". Su Partido Popular encabeza las encuestas y, para él, las elecciones "van de que España gane a Sánchez y lo que representa". Desde el ultraderechista Vox, en cambio, optaron por agitar dudas sin sustento sobre el voto por correo, mientras que las formaciones minoritarias de izquierda apuran diálogos para una posible alianza. item.description: Brazil is set for a presidential run-off after right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro won a surprise first-round victory, threatening Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s grip on power in South America’s largest economy. Bolsonaro, son of imprisoned former president Jair Bolsonaro, took 47 per cent of the ballots in Sunday’s election, beating out Lula on 45 per cent. Brazilians will vote again on October 25 as neither candidate got the 50 per cent share needed to claim outright victory. US-China... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Quebec poised to elect separatists to power for first time in more than a decade
item.description: Parti Québécois promises to hold independence referendum in Canada’s French-speaking region by 2028 Voters in Quebec are going to the polls in provincial elections which will probably result in victory for a party that has promised to hold a referendum on independence from Canada within the next two years. If polls are correct, the Parti Québécois (PQ) will form the government of the province of roughly nine million, the first time that the separatist movement will have gained power in the French-speaking region for more than a decade. item.title: Brazil's presidential election heads to runoff between Bolsonara and Lula
item.description: Brazil presidential candidate Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro and incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will face off in a runoff October 25 for the top job after neither won a majority in Sunday's vote. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Spain's prime minister calls early elections as pressure mounts over housing crisis
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced early elections Monday after his government suffered a bruising legislative defeat last week on emergency measures related to the country's housing crisis. Fuente: NPR - World.
